title: Neon Courier — One-Button Rooftop Heist

checks.name: JavaScript syntax
checks.details: game.js parsed cleanly with Node's syntax checker (exit 0).

checks.name: Local-only static contract
checks.command: python3 inline scan of index.html styles.css game.js README.md
checks.details: Required files are non-empty. HTML wires local canvas, CSS, and JS. No http/https URLs, no iframes. game.js contains coyote, buffer, dash, combo, localStorage, reduced-motion, attract, and fixed-timestep markers. README documents Space and architecture.

checks.name: Headless attract-mode 7s run
checks.command: node stubbed-canvas simulation of requestAnimationFrame for 9s
checks.details: Attract mode produced both jump and dash poses and remained alive through 7.0s (first crash at ~8.08s). Title HUD, objective text, and rooftop prologue ran without exceptions.

checks.name: First-input play transition and reduced motion
checks.command: node stubbed-canvas with matchMedia reduce plus Space keydown
checks.details: Space during attract reset the courier to a fresh playable run. Reduced-motion media query did not throw. Collision timing path still updated.

summary: Direct-open Canvas 2D rooftop runner with one-button jump/charge/dash, seeded procedural roofs, attract-mode demo, scoring/combo/best persistence, and reduced-motion support.
known_issues: Best score uses localStorage; some browsers restrict storage on file:// even though the run still plays.
